reasoning.step1:
1) Classify document as invoice:
- Presence of header "Rechnung", invoice-like sections ("Rechnungsdetails", line items), invoice identifiers ("Belegnr. 31691688 v. 17.01.2024"), totals block. No exclusion terms like "Mahnung" prominent. Conclusion: treat as invoice.

2) Locate Invoice.Date:
- Multiple "v. 17.01.2024" near Belegnr./Lieferschein. Standard invoice issue date found as "v. 17.01.2024". Extract Invoice.Date = "17.01.2024".

3) Identify Sender.VatId:
- Two UID values: "UID: ATU22642807" appears with the Rechnungsempfänger/BÄKO (recipient). Footer with company data (NÖM AG) lists "UID: ATU23264205". Sender is NÖM AG (invoice issuer). Therefore Sender.VatId = "ATU23264205".

4) Find GrandTotal.Amount:
- Totals block on page 2 shows:
  - Gesamtbetrag exkl. 1.448,09
  - Umsatzsteuer 10,00% von 1.448,09 = 144,81
  - Rechnungsbetrag 1.592,90
- Grand total (Rechnungsbetrag) = 1.592,90 -> convert European decimal comma to dot for numeric value: 1592.90.
- GrandTotal.Amount = 1592.90

5) Extract VAT rate(s) and corresponding net/vat amounts:
- Totals show single VAT group: "Umsatzsteuer 10,00% von 1.448,09 144,81" — one VAT rate 10%.
- Per rules, Vat.Rate should be number without "%" -> 10.
- Net.Amount (for that VAT group) is 1.448,09 -> 1448.09.
- Vat.Amount is 144,81 -> 144.81.
- Maintain decimal places as in input (two decimals).

6) Verify no contradicting exchange rates or multiple VAT groups:
- All line items list 10% Ust column; totals show only one VAT group. No invoice-level exchange rate present.

7) Check No Inference and completeness:
- All required fields found directly in document; no guessing needed.
reasoning.step2:
GrandTotal.Amount — High confidence (~95%):
- "Rechnungsbetrag 1.592,90" clearly printed in totals block. Numeric conversion to 1592.90 is straightforward. No conflicting total elsewhere.

Invoice.Date — High confidence (~95%):
- Multiple occurrences "v. 17.01.2024" adjacent to Belegnr./Lieferschein; consistent issue date format. No other date competing as invoice date.

Sender.VatId — High confidence (~90%):
- Two UID values present: ATU22642807 (customer BÄKO) and UID: ATU23264205 in footer with NÖM AG company data. Sender is NÖM AG; selected UID matches sender footer. Slight uncertainty only if footer UID could be different legal entity, but evidence strongly supports ATU23264205.

Vat.Rate — Very high confidence (~99%):
- Totals state "Umsatzsteuer 10,00%"; line items Ust column shows 10. Single VAT group present.

Net.Amount — High confidence (~95%):
- Totals show "Gesamtbetrag exkl. 1.448,09" matching base for VAT calculation. Converted to 1448.09. No contradictory net total.

Vat.Amount — High confidence (~98%):
- Totals list VAT amount "144,81" corresponding to 10% of 1.448,09; conversion to 144.81 straightforward.

Overall consistency:
- VAT rate, net amount, and VAT amount mathematically consistent with grand total (1448.09 + 144.81 = 1592.90).
